rationale: BLOCKED. I read the complete held EO 13189 (66 FR 5421, Jan. 15, 2001; Federal Interagency Task Force on the District of Columbia): sec. 2 establishes the Task Force (chair: OMB Director), secs. 3-6 state its purposes and duties, sec. 7 is a no-private-right clause. It has no own sunset, expiry or trigger term and no savings clause. The sole history observation is an empty catalog disposition note, which does not establish current effect. No acting instrument text is held (a text search of the held texts for the Task Force name finds only EO 13189 itself). The Task Force was a Clinton-era creation and whether a later order revoked or superseded it is plausible but unverified; I have no held source, so I record no leaning beyond that suspicion. A source for the ending, or a held current-status predicate, is needed.
